background_story: Kenzie was a unique and fascinating dung beetle who lived in the scorching savannah. Unlike her peers, Kenzie had a special gift - she could predigest the toughest plant material, breaking it down into nutrient-rich compounds that her colony could easily absorb. This extraordinary ability made her a vital member of the community, as she could provide sustenance for her fellow beetles during times of scarcity. Kenzie's talent was so renowned that she was often sought out by other insects and even small animals, who would trade valuable resources for a taste of her predigested delicacies. As a result, Kenzie's colony thrived, and she became a celebrated figure in the insect world, known for her remarkable digestive prowess and generosity.
